## Pages
- [About NeuroDigital Support | Inclusive digital well-being](/about): Learn how NeuroDigital Support designs research-driven digital products that prioritise neurodivergent wellbeing, accessibility, and inclusive support.
- [Admin Dashboard | NeuroDigital Support](/admin): No description available
- [Care Logging | NeuroDigital Support](/carelogging): Care Logging lets care homes and supported living teams securely record daily routines, incidents, mood and sensory observations, and generate exportable reports for reviews and audits.
- [Contact NeuroDigital Support | Demo, partnership, support](/contact): Contact NeuroDigital Support for demos, partnerships, accessibility advice, research enquiries, or support for autistic and neurodivergent adults.
- [Digital Advocacy Hub | NeuroDigital Support](/digitaladvocacyhub): The Digital Advocacy Hub brings together campaigns, educational resources, and practical tools that support neurodiversity awareness and accessible societal change.
- [Features | NeuroDigital Support ecosystem](/features): Explore NeuroDigital Support’s full digital ecosystem, including wellbeing, social, advocacy, research, and care tools built for neurodivergent adults and teams.
- [NeuroDigital Support | Inclusive digital support for neurodivergent adults](/home): NeuroDigital Support builds sensory-aware digital platforms for autistic and neurodivergent adults, offering calm interfaces, wellbeing tools, and inclusive support services.
- [OliTok | NeuroDigital Support](/olitok): OliTok is a safe, structured companionship platform that connects autistic and neurodivergent individuals with trained volunteers who provide friendship, encouragement, conversation, and emotional support in a respectful online environment.
- [Social Listening Dashboard | NeuroDigital Support](/sociallisteningdashboard): A smart analytics dashboard designed to monitor public conversations, identify emerging themes, and support evidence-led understanding of neurodivergent digital experiences.
